titles.title: American Decade of Sports Act
American Decade of Sports Act
American Decade of Sports Act

A bill to require a sports diplomacy strategy to strategically leverage the major sporting events being hosted in the United States during the next decade to enhance United States soft power, diplomatic relationships, and global leadership, and for other purposes.
